---
# DRAFT copy for Douglas's approval before launch (README, "Launch checklist").
title: "CV"
description: "Douglas Fritz's curriculum vitae, and how it is kept from the same data as this site."
---

```{r}
#| label: site-setup
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# The download (link, size and last-updated date) is rendered only when the
# approved PDF named in data/site.yml exists at build time
# (R/site_summary.R); the chunk returns its block (knitr::asis_output).
root <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")
if (!nzchar(root)) stop("Render this page with Quarto from the project (QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR is not set).")
site_code <- new.env()
for (file in c("config.R", "pillar_cards.R", "site_summary.R")) sys.source(file.path(root, "R", file), envir = site_code)
```

My CV and this website draw on one spreadsheet of publications, presentations and other entries. The CV is typeset from it with R and the vitae package, which keeps maintaining the record separate from formatting it. This site is built from the same spreadsheet with R and Quarto: only the entries marked for the website are published, and each rebuild updates the publication and talk archives.

```{r}
#| label: cv-download
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
knitr::asis_output(site_code$cv_download_block(root))
```
